properties.whose_line: OpenStreetMap mappers: the extent of Nepal's claim beyond India's line
properties.notes: Two parties, two lines: Nepal's claim and India's line; neither found as data. HDX COD-AB Nepal (Survey Department) does not follow Nepal's claim (it holds 66 of these 410 km²). DoS's 'Kalapani' (60 km²) is DoS's own line, not agreed, so not rank 2. Natural Earth's 'Near Om Parvat' (60 km²) is a different, smaller object.
properties.operation: assembled from the OSM element's member ways (outer minus inner)
properties.crs: WGS84 longitude/latitude, as in the source (no reprojection)

source_features.name: Extent of Nepalese Claims at Kalapani Territory
